question: A solid conducting sphere is in electrostatic equilibrium with net charge +Q. Consider two concentric spherical Gaussian surfaces: S₁ lies just inside the metal (within the conducting material), and S₂ lies just outside the sphere in air. What are the total electric fluxes through S₁ and S₂?

options.D: Both depend on the exact radii of S₁ and S₂
